texts.fd_add_item: Saka kaya a kwando da farko.
texts.fd_ask_manager: Manaja ko mai shi zai iya taimakawa.
texts.fd_check_retry: Duba shi, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
texts.fd_email_format: Shigar da adireshin imel kamar name@example.com.
texts.fd_email_throwaway: Wannan adireshin imel yana ɗaukar ɗan lokaci kawai. Yi amfani da adireshin da za ka riƙe.
texts.fd_enter_cash: Rubuta cikakken adadin da abokin ciniki ya bayar.
texts.fd_go_online: Haɗa da intanet, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
texts.fd_long: Lambobi a {country} suna da haruffan lamba {n}. Ba a ƙara ƙarin haruffa.
texts.fd_match_retry: Nemi sabuwar lamba daga ɗayan na'urar, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
texts.fd_needs_approval: Aika shi don amincewa da farko.
texts.fd_our_side: Wani abu ya lalace daga ɓangarenmu. Ba laifinka ba ne.
texts.fd_owner_access: Mai shi zai iya ba ka dama.
texts.fd_owner_plan: Mai shi zai iya zaɓar babban tsari daga sashen kuɗin biyan kuɗi da iyakoki.
texts.fd_ref: Lambar bibiya {ref}. Ka faɗe ta idan ka tuntuɓi tallafi.
texts.fd_short: Wannan lambar ta yi gajeru sosai. Lambobi a {country} suna da haruffan lamba {n}.
texts.fd_use_code: Buɗe hanyar haɗin ko rubuta lambar daga gayyatarka.
texts.fd_use_ticket: Yi amfani da tikitin da kake da shi, ko ka bar wannan layin da farko.
texts.fd_wait_retry: Jira ɗan lokaci, sannan ka sake gwadawa.
texts.fd_wait_tomorrow: Za ka iya sake aikawa gobe.
